source.dataset: City of Edmonton Open Data — Property and Education Tax Rates (2014 onward)

notes: Revenue phase uses the MUNICIPAL rate only (City fiscal framing; education levy is provincial). Education rates are stored here for provenance/transparency, not used in the computation.

Join key is the assessment `Tax Class` field (Residential / Non Residential / Other Residential / Farmland). Source class names use spaces ('Non Residential'); some historical years use a hyphenated 'Non-Residential' variant — normalize on load.

FARMLAND 2025 is an ASSUMPTION, not published: the source dropped a separate Farmland class in 2025. Municipal Farmland == Municipal Residential in every year 2014-2024, so 2025 Farmland municipal is set = Residential (7.6254). Flag, do not treat as authoritative. Low impact (509 farmland parcels).

'Mature Area Derelict Residential' and 'Transitional Residential' are source rate classes that do not appear in the assessment `Tax Class` field; retained for fidelity but unused by the Tax-Class join.

Farmland._assumed: no 2025 Farmland row published; set = Residential municipal (Farmland==Residential every year 2014-2024)
